description: List the ids of the transfer drafts this user sealed that are neither spent nor expired, newest first: draft_id, expires_at, and approval_session_id once the phone approval was requested (empty before). A draft whose approval was rejected stays listed until it expires, so read the approval status before acting. Use it when the draft or approval ids from earlier in the conversation are not in front of you, for example when the user says they approved on their phone; the newest draft is the one they just discussed. Moves no money.
name: list_open_transfer_drafts
title: List Open Mcp Transfer Drafts
